neighbours.label: ' next' or ' every' after 'in': 'in the next couple weeks', 'in every season'; not 'until next time'
fire: In the next few days, crews will finish.
We may have to drive to town in the next hour or two.
Bring the kids outside in every weather.
In the next couple months, staff will move.
The bill could pass in the next day or so.
Birds return to the marsh in every season.
Over the next several days it will rain.
quiet: In the old days, crews would finish.
We may have to drive to town in the rain or snow.
Bring the kids outside in the summer.
In the past, staff would move.
Birds return to the marsh in the spring.
Over the hills it will rain.

notes: The - pole of this neuron fires on ' this' and ' next' before ' time' or ' year', which the output direction also promotes. ' this' after 'in' (in this case) scored 0.08 in a probe and is left out.
